title: Location Management History paginator — a decimal page number ('2.5') is silently coerced to a different page (25) instead of being rejected
requirementSource: specs_planning/_internal/field-case-generation.md §2.1 — a rejected value must be announced and escapable, and a silent coercion to a different value is a defect. NM3937-13 'Next/previous navigation loads the correct result segment'. The same input already rejects '0', '-1', 'abc' and one-past-the-end by reverting to the current page, so '2.5' should be handled the same way (or truncated to 2).
stepsToReproduce: Open https://cloudapps-e2e.encoreglobal.com/navigator/locations/1604/settings/location and click the Location Management History tab.
Click the page-number box (aria-label 'Current page number'), press Ctrl+A then Backspace so it is empty.
Type '2.5' key by key and press Enter.
expectedBehavior: The value is rejected (the box reverts to the current page, as for '0', '-1' and 'abc') or truncated to page 2.
actualBehavior: The '.' is stripped and the digits concatenated: the grid silently jumps to page 25, with no message. The user lands 23 pages away from the page they asked for.

mcpEvidence.findings: Box emptied (value ''), '2.5' typed + Enter. Box then reads '25'; the only history request issued was POST /navigator/api/location/get-location-setting-history {"locationNo":"1604","isCorporate":true,"page":25,"pageSize":20,"sortBy":"ModDate","sortDescending":true}. Pinned as a known defect in TC-LOC-MGH-042.

networkEvidence: Request page=25 for typed input '2.5' — the coercion happens client-side before the request.
relatedObservation: The shared paginator shows the same behaviour on Local Office Settings History (pinned in TC-LOE-HIST-039); fixing the component should fix both.

verificationLog.detail: Owner ruling in chat, 2026-09-23 (Nikita Nangare): the page box turning '2.5' into page 25 is working as expected, not a defect. The observed facts stand; only the classification changes. TC-LOC-MGH-042 keeps pinning the behaviour as the accepted contract.
